Sentensi ze mpanvu ne bwe zigeraageranyizibwa n’omutindo gw’ekyasa ekye kkumi n’omusanvu, buli kimu akissaako obukwakkulizo, era takozesa kitundu kya sentensi kimu we biyinza okubeera bina. Mikwano gye baakyemulugunyako ng’akyali mulamu. Amawulire amalungi gali nti byonna tebikyaliko bwannannyini, nti ebimu ku bitabo bye ebisinga obulungi biriwo mu bufunze obulungi ennyo obw’omulembe guno, era nti obufunze obwo bwe busaanidde okutandikirako. Tewali kirungi kiri mu kulwanagana n’ekitabo ekinene ekijjuvu nga omukugu mu kulongoosa ebitabo amaze okukola omulimu.

Tandikira wano

The Reformed Pastor (1656). Ekitabo kye ekisinga okugasa era ekikyasomebwa. Ebitabo eby’omulembe guno ebikifunza biba n’empapula nga bibiri era tebibulwamu kintu kikulu. Buli musumba, mukadde w’ekkanisa n’omusomesa w’essomero lya Ssande asaanye okukisoma omulundi gumu, ng’ajjukira okulabula okuli mu ssuula Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya. Okukoowoola eri Abatannakyuka (A Call to the Unconverted, 1658). Kimpi, kyangu, era kyawandiikirwa abantu abatasoma nnyo. Kikyasobola okuweebwa ng’ekirabo eky’okubunyisa Enjiri. The Saints’ Everlasting Rest (1650), mu bufunze. Ekitabo ekijjuvu kirina ebitundu bina ebinene; obufunze obusinga bukuuma ennyonnyola y’eggulu n’ebiragiro by’okufumiitiriza ku bya waggulu, era ebyo abasomi abasinga bye baagala.

Ku bulamu bw’Omukristaayo

Dying Thoughts (1683). Okufumiitiriza ku Abafiripi 1:23, kwe yawandiika ng’akaddiye. Kimpi era kikwata ku mutima. The Life of Faith. Gwe musingi gw’essuula Obulamu bw’Okukkiriza; ku kubeera omulamu olw’ebitalabika. The Poor Man’s Family Book. Kyawandiikirwa amaka agataasoma nnyo, mu ngeri y’emboozi. Kiraga bulungi engeri gye yayigirizangamu ddala. A Breviate of the Life of Margaret Baxter (1681). Ebyafaayo bye yawandiika ku mukyala we, nga wayise wiiki ntono okuva lwe yafa. Si by’eddiini, era kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga okukwata ku mutima mu kyasa ekyo — nnamwandu ng’annyonnyola omukazi gwe yalaba mu lwatu nti amusinga.

Omulimu omunene ogw’obulamu obwa bulijjo

A Christian Directory (1673). Ekitabo ekinene ennyo eky’okulagirira mu by’eddiini eby’obulamu obwa bulijjo ne ku nsonga z’omuntu ow’omunda, ekirimu ebigambo nga akakadde kamu, ekikwata ku kusinza okw’ekyama, obulamu bw’amaka, enkolagana mu kkanisa n’ensonga ez’olukale. Tekisaanye kusomebwa okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Kitabo kya kwebuuzaako, era kirungi okukyebuuzaako ku kibuuzo kyonna eky’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo ky’osobola okulowoozaako, kubanga kumpi mu butuufu yakyogerako.

Ku kwennyamira

Ebiwandiiko bya Baxter ku kwennyamira n’ennaku esukkiridde, ebyogerwako mu ssuula Okubuulirira Abennyamivu, bisaasaanidde era tebyangu kufuna, naye kirungi okubinoonya. Byali bisoose ebyasa bisatu ku bingi ku ebyo ebyaddirira era bikyali mu kubuulirira okw’Ekikristaayo okusinga amagezi ku nsonga eno. Bisome ng’ojjukira ekigambo eky’omulembe guno ekiri mu ssuula eyo: noonya obuyambi bw’abasawo abakugu.

Soma n’obwegendereza

Aphorisms of Justification (1649) n’olunyiriri oluwanvu olw’ebiwandiiko eby’empaka ebyakiddirira. Bino bye byogerwako mu ssuula ku kukkiriza n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Bisome kyokka bw’oba oyagala okutegeera empaka ezo, era osome n’okuwakanya kwabyo wamu nabyo. Ebitabo eby’empaka okutwaliza awamu. Bingi nnyo, bikooya, era Baxter yennyini yejjusa obungi bwabyo n’obukambwe bwabyo.

Ebyafaayo bye yennyini

Reliquiae Baxterianae, ebyafaayo bye bye yawandiika, ebyafulumizibwa mu 1696 ng’amaze okufa. Ekiwandiiko ekijjuvu kizibu okukwata; obufunze obumanyiddwa bwangu nnyo okusoma era bulimu ekitundu ekimanyiddwa ennyo ku ngeri ebirowoozo bye gye byakyukamu ng’akaddiwa, ekyo nga kye kintu kimu ekisinga obulungi kye yawandiika ku ye yennyini.

Ebimwogerako

Richard Baxter (1965) ekya Geoffrey Nuttall kye kitabo ekimpi era ekyesigika eky’abayivu ku bulamu bwe. J. I. Packer yawandiika omulimu gwe ogw’obwa dokita ku by’eddiini bya Baxter era n’amuddangako emirundi mingi oluvannyuma; essuula ku Baxter mu A Quest for Godliness kye kiwandiiko ekimpi ekisinga obulungi ekimusiima ekiriwo, era zoogera mu lwatu ku buzibu bw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. N. H. Keeble yawandiika bulungi ku Baxter ng’omuwandiisi ne ku nsi y’abaali batakkiriza nkola ya kkanisa ya ggwanga mwe yabeeranga. Soma ebisukka mu kimu. Baxter asikiriza abamwagala abatafaayo ku bibi bye, n’abamunenya abatafaayo ku kintu kirala kyonna.

Okubuulirira kusatu ku kumusoma

Sooka osome obufunze, era awatali nsonyi. Abalongoosa ebitabo baggyamu okuddiŋŋana, so si ekikulu. Musome olw’omugugu gw’alina ku mutima so si olw’ensengeka ye. W’asukka ku Byawandiikibwa — era ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu bw’atyo bw’akola — twala okufaayo kwe okw’obusumba, oleke ensengeka. Era musome mu bitundu bitono. Baxter mugagga era muzito, era empapula ntono ezigaayiddwa zijja kukola bingi okusinga empapula amakumi ataano ezigumiikiriziddwa. Ye yennyini yandyogedde kye kimu; yakyogera ku biwandiiko bye yennyini emirundi egisukka mu gumu.

Mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:21
